entities.name: Kishan Lal
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Kishan Lal was an Indian field hockey player. He captained the Indian hockey team at the 1948 Summer Olympics to gold, winning independent India's first gold medal by defeating Great Britain 4-0 in the final.
